title: TCSExam: Evaluating Frontier LLMs on the Full Range of TCS Research
summary: TCSExam evaluates language-model agents across theorem proving, solver engineering, mathematical constructions and attempts at open conjectures. The 100-task full benchmark and 20-task subset compared eight and nine agents respectively; Lean or executable checkers checked outputs. The benchmark does not establish priority for a mathematical result or capability beyond its sampled tasks.
ai_technology: Frontier large language models evaluated with Lean and executable checkers
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: Eight agents were evaluated on 100 expert-reviewed tasks and nine on a 20-task subset; Lean kernels or executable checkers validated outputs where applicable.
evidence.unknown: Benchmark rankings and checked task outputs do not establish priority for any theorem or broad research capability beyond the sampled tasks.
evidence.ai_role: LLM agents attempted proof, solver-engineering, construction and conjecture tasks; checkers validated outputs where applicable.
